title: koeleria pubescens var. longiglumis
intro: Koeleria pubescens var. longiglumis, commonly known as a type of grass, is a plant species in the family Poaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine, particularly in Eastern Europe and Asia, where it is valued for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing fever, relieving pain, and improving overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Koeleria pubescens var. longiglumis include its ability to reduce inflammation, modulate the immune system, and exhibit antimicrobial and antiviral activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
